===/developers/advanced-api-usage/prompt-caching===
# Prompt Caching

> The xAI API performs prompt caching **automatically**.

===/developers/advanced-api-usage/prompt-caching/best-practices===
# Best Practices & FAQ

## Supported models

Prompt caching is available on all `grok` language models.

===/developers/advanced-api-usage/prompt-caching/maximizing-cache-hits===
# Maximizing Cache Hits

## Set `x-grok-conv-id` (Chat Completions API)

```bash
curl https://api.x.ai/v1/chat/completions -d '{"model": "grok-4.7"}'
```

## Set `prompt_cache_key` (Responses API)

```bash
curl https://api.x.ai/v1/responses -d '{"model": "grok-4.7"}'
```
